sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: Today, the Senate votes to adopt the rules that will govern the rest of the impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 今天，参议院投票通过了将指导其余弹劾审判程序的规则。

sentences.en: Julie Davis on why they were not the rules that Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell had originally wanted.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯将解析为什么这些规则并非参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔最初想要的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, January 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月22日星期三。

sentences.en: The Senate will come to order.
sentences.zh: 参议院现在开会。

sentences.en: The chaplain, Dr. Black, will open the Senate with prayer.
sentences.zh: 参议院牧师布莱克博士将以祈祷开启参议院会议。

sentences.en: So, on Tuesday, Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell opens the Senate for this first day of the official impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 因此，在周二，参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔开启了官方弹劾审判的第一天。

sentences.en: The Senate's process will draw a sharp contrast with the unfair and precedent-breaking inquiry that was carried on by the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 参议院的程序将与众议院进行的、不公正且打破先例的调查形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: He has spent weeks decrying the House impeachment inquiry as completely partisan and unfair.
sentences.zh: 他花了数周时间谴责众议院的弹劾调查完全是党派偏见且不公正的。

sentences.en: — Finally, some fairness.
sentences.zh: ——终于有了一点公正。

sentences.en: On every point, our straightforward resolution will bring the clarity and fairness that everyone deserves.
sentences.zh: 在每一个问题上，我们直截了当的决议都将带来每个人应得的清晰与公正。

sentences.en: — And he's essentially saying this is our chance to show that we can do our duty as senators.
sentences.zh: ——而他基本上是在说，这是我们展示能够履行参议员职责的机会。

sentences.en: And —
sentences.zh: 并且——

sentences.en: — Today's vote will contain some answers.
sentences.zh: ——今天的投票将包含一些答案。

sentences.en: — Today, we're going to find out whether that's possible.
sentences.zh: ——今天，我们将找出这是否可能。

sentences.en: — Democratic Leader.
sentences.zh: ——民主党领袖。

sentences.en: — Now, before I begin —
sentences.zh: ——现在，在我开始之前——

sentences.en: — And then Chuck Schumer, the Democratic leader, gets up to make his speech.
sentences.zh: ——然后民主党领袖查克·舒默起身发表讲话。

sentences.en: — The McConnell rules seem to be designed by President Trump for President Trump.
sentences.zh: ——麦康奈尔的规则似乎是由特朗普总统为特朗普总统量身定制的。

sentences.en: — And it's like they're on different planets.
sentences.zh: ——这感觉就像他们身处不同的星球。

sentences.en: He essentially says,
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，

sentences.en: Mitch McConnell is pushing for this process that's completely unfair.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔正在推动这个完全不公正的程序。

sentences.en: There's nothing fair about this.
sentences.zh: 这毫无公正可言。

sentences.en: It's completely skewed toward President Trump and what he wants to see in this trial, which Schumer says is basically a cover-up.
sentences.zh: 它完全偏向特朗普总统以及他希望在这场审判中看到的结果，舒默称这基本上是一场掩盖。

sentences.en: — If the president is so confident in his case, if Leader McConnell is so confident the president did nothing wrong, why don't they want the case to be presented in broad daylight?
sentences.zh: ——如果总统对自己的案件如此有信心，如果麦康奈尔领袖对总统没有做错事如此有信心，为什么他们不想在众目睽睽之下陈述案情？

sentences.en: — On something as important as impeachment, the McConnell resolution is nothing short of a national disgrace.
sentences.zh: ——在弹劾这样的大事上，麦康奈尔的决议简直是国家的耻辱。

sentences.en: — This will go down, this resolution, as one of the darker moments in the Senate history.
sentences.zh: ——这项决议将作为参议院历史上最黑暗的时刻之一载入史册。

sentences.en: Perhaps one of even the darkeSt.
sentences.zh: 或许还是最黑暗的时刻之一。

sentences.en: — What exactly are these two men really bickering over here?
sentences.zh: ——这两个人在这里到底在争吵些什么？

sentences.en: — Well, for some time now, there has been this behind-the-scenes debate about what the rules were going to look like.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，一段时间以来，关于规则会是什么样子，一直存在着幕后辩论。

sentences.en: Mitch McConnell has repeatedly said...
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔一再表示……

sentences.en: — The structure for this impeachment trial should track with the structure of the Clinton trial.
sentences.zh: ——这次弹劾审判的结构应该效仿克林顿弹劾案的结构。

sentences.en: We have a precedent here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里有先例。

sentences.en: — Don't worry.
sentences.zh: ——别担心。

sentences.en: This is going to be modeled on exactly the same rules that were adopted unanimously in 1999 when Bill Clinton's impeachment trial was about to begin.
sentences.zh: 这将完全以1999年比尔·克林顿弹劾审判即将开始时一致通过的规则为蓝本。

sentences.en: And Democrats have essentially been waiting to see what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 民主党人基本上一直在等待看看那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Is that actually going to be the case?
sentences.zh: 事实真的会是这样吗？

sentences.en: And for a long time now, we have expected to see a copy of this resolution, and it's not materializing.
sentences.zh: 而且很长一段时间以来，我们一直期望看到这份决议的副本，但它迟迟没有出现。

sentences.en: — Leader McConnell has still not come up with his proposal.
sentences.zh: ——麦康奈尔领袖仍然没有提出他的提案。

sentences.en: That's unheard of.
sentences.zh: 这闻所未闻。

sentences.en: — And as the senators are debating these rules, and Schumer is demanding to see what Senator McConnell is going to propose,
sentences.zh: ——正当参议员们辩论这些规则，而舒默要求查看麦康奈尔参议员将提出什么方案时，

sentences.en: comes the deadline on Saturday evening for the White House to make its first filing in the impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 白宫在周六晚上迎来了提交其在弹劾审判中的第一份法律文件的截止日期。

sentences.en: And the president's lawyers lay out basically what they're going to argue in this trial.
sentences.zh: 总统的律师们基本上阐述了他们在这场审判中要辩护的内容。

sentences.en: They call on the Senate to swiftly reject these impeachment charges.
sentences.zh: 他们呼吁参议院迅速驳回这些弹劾指控。

sentences.en: That's a quote from the filing.
sentences.zh: 这是文件中的原话。

sentences.en: And acquit the president because the charges themselves are without foundation
sentences.zh: 并宣告总统无罪，因为指控本身毫无根据，

sentences.en: and, in fact, would weaken the office of the presidency if the Senate agreed to remove him for these charges.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果参议院同意因这些指控罢免他，将会削弱总统办公室的权威。

sentences.en: — The president's legal team, Alan Dershowitz, Professor Ramirez at Harvard Law School, also the author of the new book, Guilt by Association.
sentences.zh: ——总统的法律团队，艾伦·德肖维茨，哈佛法学院教授拉米雷斯，也是新书《因关联而有罪》的作者。

sentences.en: Professor Dershowitz, thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 德肖维茨教授，感谢您加入我们。

sentences.en: — Thank you.
sentences.zh: ——谢谢。

sentences.en: — Is it your position that President Trump should not be impeached, even if all the evidence and arguments laid out by the House are accepted as fact?
sentences.zh: ——您的立场是，即使众议院提出的所有证据和论点都被当作事实接受，特朗普总统也不应被弹劾吗？

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: — Number one, they say...
sentences.zh: ——第一，他们说……

sentences.en: — The vote was to impeach on abuse of power, which is not within the constitutional criteria for impeachment and obstruction of Congress.
sentences.zh: ——投票结果是以滥用权力（这不在宪法规定的弹劾标准之内）和妨碍国会罪名通过的。

sentences.en: — The impeachment charges do not actually allege any violation of a law.
sentences.zh: ——弹劾指控并未实际指控任何违法行为。

sentences.en: There's no crime here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有犯罪。

sentences.en: Abuse of power, they say, in the way that House Democrats have framed it, is essentially criminalizing the president doing his job.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，按照众议院民主党人构筑的方式，滥用权力本质上是将总统履行职务的行为刑事化。

sentences.en: Number two, they say all of the findings that came forth in the House impeachment inquiry, the whole inquiry itself, is essentially fruits of a poison tree.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们说众议院弹劾调查中产生的所有调查结果、整个调查本身，本质上都是毒树之果。

sentences.en: The Democrats had a political vendetta against President Trump and decided to impeach him at all costs.
sentences.zh: 民主党人对特朗普总统抱有政治私怨，决定不惜一切代价弹劾他。

sentences.en: And so anything that was uncovered, anything they unearthed in this inquiry, is by definition illegitimate and can't really be considered as part of an impeachment proceeding,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这场调查中发现的任何东西、挖掘出的任何东西，按定义都是非法的，不能真正作为弹劾审判的一部分来审视，

sentences.en: that it's not really a constitutional thing because of the way Democrats conducted the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 由于民主党人进行调查的方式，它在宪法层面上根本站不住脚。

sentences.en: — And so shortly after the president's legal team files its brief,
sentences.zh: ——因此，在总统法律团队提交其简报后不久，

sentences.en: Senator McConnell finally comes out with this draft of the resolution that he's going to offer to govern the procedures for the trial.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔参议员终于拿出了他将用来规范审判程序的决议草案。

sentences.en: — For the rules.
sentences.zh: ——关于规则的。

sentences.en: — For the rules, exactly.
sentences.zh: ——关于规则的，没错。

sentences.en: And it looks a lot like the kinds of ground rules that the president's team would want based on what they've said in their filing.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很像总统团队根据其提交的文件所希望看到的基本规则。

sentences.en: — What do you mean?
sentences.zh: ——你是什么意思？

sentences.en: — Well, remember, Mitch McConnell kept saying—
sentences.zh: ——嗯，记住，米奇·麦康奈尔一直在说——

sentences.en: — Essentially the same, very similar—
sentences.zh: ——基本上是一样的，非常相似——

sentences.en: — that he was going to model these rules after—
sentences.zh: ——他将以什么为蓝本制定这些规则——

sentences.en: — In the Clinton trial.
sentences.zh: ——在克林顿审判中。

sentences.en: — The trial rules for Bill Clinton's impeachment.
sentences.zh: ——比尔·克林顿弹劾案的审判规则。

sentences.en: Under those rules, each side had 24 hours to argue their opening case and could use as many days as it would take to do that.
sentences.zh: 根据这些规则，双方各有24小时陈述开案陈词，并且可以根据需要使用任意多天来完成。

sentences.en: In the Clinton trial, that meant three days on each side.
sentences.zh: 在克林顿审判中，这意味着双方各三天。

sentences.en: — This resolution specifically limits the time frame to two days for each side.
sentences.zh: ——这项决议明确将时间框架限制为双方各两天。

sentences.en: So, yes, you can have 24 hours, but you've got to finish your argument within two days.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你可以有24小时，但你必须在两天内完成你的论点。

sentences.en: — Why is that significant, one day?
sentences.zh: ——为什么这很重要，少了一天？

sentences.en: — Well, it means if you're going to compress it into two days, it means, first of all, very long days because you're starting at 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，这意味着如果你要把它压缩到两天，首先意味着非常长的工作日，因为你从下午1点开始。

sentences.en: And if you're dividing 24 hours into two days, that's 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 如果你把24小时平分到两天，那就是每天12小时。

sentences.en: You're going till 1 a.m.
sentences.zh: 你要一直开会到凌晨1点。

sentences.en: That means a lot of these arguments unfolding at hours when most people are in bed and not watching or listening, which may be the point.
sentences.zh: 这意味着许多辩论展开的时间正是大多数人在睡觉、没有观看或收听的时候，这也许正是他们的目的。

sentences.en: And secondly, it means a much faster trial overall.
sentences.zh: 其次，这意味着整体审判速度要快得多。

sentences.en: It lets the president's defense put up their case much quicker, but it also means that the entire opening phase of the trial is basically over by the end of the week
sentences.zh: 它让总统的辩护方更快地提出他们的案件，但也意味着审判的整个开场阶段基本上在周末结束时就结束了，

sentences.en: and we're on to potentially a vote the following week.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来可能会在第二周进行投票。

sentences.en: — So, longer days, shorter trial, clearly a benefit for the president.
sentences.zh: ——所以，开会时间更长，审判时间更短，对总统显然有利。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: Secondly, there was another key difference here, and that was that instead of just admitting the House impeachment inquiry findings into evidence at the outset,
sentences.zh: 其次，这里还有一个关键区别，那就是，不是在开始时直接将众议院弹劾调查的结果作为证据采纳，

sentences.en: which is what they did in the Clinton trial, this set of rules would say, we'll print all of the materials that the House impeachment inquiry produced
sentences.zh: 就像他们在克林顿审判中所做的那样，这套规则规定，我们将打印众议院弹劾调查产生的所有材料

sentences.en: and distribute them to senators, but actually they will not be entered into evidence at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 并分发给参议员，但实际上它们在开始时不会被作为证据输入。

sentences.en: And in fact, they won't even be considered until after we decide whether we're going to hear from witnesses,
sentences.zh: 事实上，在决定我们是否听取证人证词之前，它们甚至不会被考虑，

sentences.en: until after we decide whether we're going to hear new evidence not presented in the House inquiry,
sentences.zh: 在决定我们是否听取众议院调查中未曾出示的新证据之前不会被考虑，

sentences.en: and only then will it be subject to a vote whether or not to enter the House impeachment inquiry's findings into evidence.
sentences.zh: 只有在那之后，才会就是否将众议院弹劾调查结果作为证据采纳进行投票。

sentences.en: — So even the facts established by the House inquiry, even the transcripts of interviews, they're all up for debate in these rules laid out by McConnell for the Senate trial.
sentences.zh: ——因此，甚至连众议院调查确定的事实、采访记录，在麦康奈尔为参议院审判制定的这些规则中，都成了辩论的对象。

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——正是如此。

sentences.en: — The Senate will convene as a court of impeachment.
sentences.zh: ——参议院将作为弹劾法庭召集开会。

sentences.en: — Okay, so that's the situation on Tuesday as the Senate convenes.
sentences.zh: ——好的，这就是周二参议院开会时的形势。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: — If there is no objection, the journal of proceedings of the trial are approved to date.
sentences.zh: ——如果没有异议，截至目前的审判程序日志即告批准。

sentences.en: — The Senate convenes at 1 o'clock in the afternoon as an impeachment court, with Chief Justice Don Roberts presiding from the dais,
sentences.zh: ——参议院于下午1点作为弹劾法庭开会，首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨从高台主持会议，

sentences.en: with the House managers at a table to his right, and President Trump's legal team at a table to his left.
sentences.zh: 众议院诉讼管理人坐在他右侧的桌旁，特朗普总统的法律团队坐在他左侧的桌旁。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer and Mitch McConnell are at their lecterns on either side of the aisle.
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默和米奇·麦康奈尔分别站在走道两侧的演讲台前。

sentences.en: — Mr. Chief Justice.
sentences.zh: ——首席大法官先生。

sentences.en: — The majority leader is recognized.
sentences.zh: ——多数党领袖获准发言。

sentences.en: — And Senator McConnell.
sentences.zh: ——还有麦康奈尔参议员。

sentences.en: — For the further information of all senators,
sentences.zh: ——为了向所有参议员提供进一步信息，

sentences.en: I'm about to send a resolution to the desk providing for an outline of the next steps in these proceedings.
sentences.zh: 我即将向主席台提交一份决议，概述这些诉讼程序的下一步步骤。

sentences.en: — Calls up this package of rules and—
sentences.zh: ——提出了这一揽子规则，并且——

sentences.en: — Senate Resolution 483 to provide—
sentences.zh: ——参议院第483号决议旨在提供——

sentences.en: — The clerk stands up and begins to read the resolution.
sentences.zh: ——书记官站起身开始宣读决议。

sentences.en: — Which we, of course, pretty much know already.
sentences.zh: ——当然，这些我们基本上已经知道了。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: McConnell's office put out a copy of it on Monday night, so I pretty much thought I knew what was in it.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔的办公室在周一晚上发布了一份副本，所以我基本上以为我知道里面有什么。

sentences.en: I was sitting at my desk watching this on TV and kind of listening out of one ear.
sentences.zh: 我坐在办公桌前看电视直播，可以说是心不在焉地听着。

sentences.en: — Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: ——嗯哼。

sentences.en: — Including transcripts of public hearings or markups in any materials—
sentences.zh: ——包括公开听证会的记录或任何材料的标记——

sentences.en: — And I snapped, too, when I heard the word—
sentences.zh: ——当我听到那个词时，我也猛然回过神来——

sentences.en: — For a period of time not to exceed 24 hours over up to three session days.
sentences.zh: ——在不超过三个会期日内总计不超过24小时的时间段内。

sentences.en: — Three instead of two days—
sentences.zh: ——三天而不是两天——

sentences.en: — Hmm.
— Pertaining to how long each side would have to make their arguments.
sentences.zh: ——关于双方陈述论点的时间长度。

sentences.en: — And I thought to myself, did he just make a mistake?
sentences.zh: ——我心里想，他刚刚是不是犯了个错误？

sentences.en: And lo and behold, it was actually a change.
sentences.zh: 结果出乎意料，这确实是一个改变。

sentences.en: Somewhere between when Mitch McConnell put out that resolution of rules the night before and the time the clerk got up to read it,

But just didn't announce it.
